offering_description.value: Makes cooking and baking supplies, trash bags, disposable tableware, and food storage products for households. It sells branded and private-label products through grocery stores, mass merchants, warehouse clubs, and online retailers.

primary_products.value: aluminum foil, baking papers and pans; trash bags; disposable plates, bowls and cups; food storage bags and wraps; reusable food storage containers

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery chains, mass merchants, warehouse clubs, online retailers, and private-label retail customers; B2C: Households buying cooking, waste, tableware, and food storage supplies through retailers

end_markets.value: home cooking and baking; household waste disposal; disposable tableware; household food storage

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retailers buy branded and private-label cooking, waste, tableware, and food storage supplies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Converts aluminum, paper, and plastics into branded and private-label household goods sold to retailers

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States, with sales in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Cooking and baking supplies, waste bags, disposable tableware, and food storage products share household customers and retail channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Branded and private-label supply to major retail chains; third-party retail: Grocery stores, mass merchants, and warehouse clubs; online: E-commerce retailers and retail chain websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food-contact material rules and environmental and workplace safety requirements for manufacturing
